meta_title: LC Garden & Tree Services | Tree Surgeon Liverpool

hero_eyebrow: Qualified Tree Surgeons — Safe, Professional Tree Care
hero_subhead: Dangerous branches threatening your home or garden? We remove, trim and maintain trees safely and efficiently across Liverpool.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery & Garden Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From hazardous tree removal to routine maintenance, we handle every aspect of garden and tree care with precision and care.

services.title: Tree Removal
services.desc: Safe, complete removal of dead, diseased or unwanted trees of any size. We clear debris and leave your garden ready to use immediately.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Trimming
services.desc: Crown reduction, branch removal and shaping to restore health and aesthetics. Keeps your trees safe and prevents damage to property or nearby structures.

services.title: Emergency Tree Work
services.desc: Storm damage, fallen branches or hazardous limbs? We respond fast to make your garden safe, any day or time.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump removal below ground level using professional equipment. Reclaim usable garden space without traces of the old tree.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Full garden tidy-ups, overgrowth removal and site preparation. We haul away all waste, leaving a clean, managed garden.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming and shaping keeps boundaries neat and healthy. Tailored schedules to suit your garden and local wildlife.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it matters, because it does to your home and your garden.
about_para_1: LC Garden & Tree Services was founded on a simple belief: every garden deserves expert care, and every tree deserves respect. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation across Liverpool for safe, professional tree surgery and conscientious garden work. We're fully trained, insured and committed to leaving every property safer and better maintained than we found it.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we're honest about what your trees need, and we always leave your garden spotless. We don't rush jobs or oversell services. Whether it's a routine trim or a complex removal, you get the same attention to detail and friendly, straightforward advice.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was overhanging the roof and dropping branches everywhere. The lads came out, quoted fair, and did a brilliant job. They were careful with the garden, cleaned up after themselves properly and finished on time. Excellent outfit. Would use again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out after the storm brought down half a sycamore across our fence. They arrived the next morning and had it sorted by lunchtime. Very professional, good price, and they made sure nothing else was damaged. Top service.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Been using LC for regular hedge cutting and garden tidy-ups for three years now. Always reliable, always friendly and they take real pride in the work. Best local gardeners we've found in Liverpool.
reviews.author: James P.
